newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soyoil up on China talk and commercial buying.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soyoil up on China talk and commercial buying.

text.p: CBOT soyoil futures turned higher at midday on talk that China was seeking soybean oil, commercial buying and midday weather outlooks indicating frost may dip into the northern fringes of the U.S. soybean growing region, traders said.
"There's talk China is looking for four or five cargoes of bean oil, Refco is buying and Dreyfus is buying oil and beans," a trader said.
Traders also said the midday weather updates indicated frost may move further south into the U.S. than previously thought.
Meteorologists early Tuesday said mostly dry weather was expected in the Midwest over the next 10 days but the temperature outlook has turned colder.
At 1235 CDT, soyoil was 0.03 to 0.12 cent per lb higher, with October up 0.09 at 23.95 cents per lb.
